newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open cautiously up as U.S. data looms.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open cautiously up as U.S. data looms.

text.p: British shares edged cautiously higher at the start of trade on Friday as a few bargain-hunters braved the market ahead of key U.S. employment numbers due at 1330 GMT, dealers said.
Dealers said the U.S. data would cast a shadow over the morning's trade, keeping many investors at bay. But the recent slide in share prices would coax some buyers into the market, they said.
The FTSE 100 index of blue-chip shares opened eight points higher and climbed to 4,232.8, up 18.2 points, by 0740 GMT. The FTSE 250 mid-cap index firmed 7.9 points to 4,512.5.
